instruction: Customize my GNOME desktop by installing and applying the Papirus icon theme from gnome-look.org.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate to gnome-look.org, download and install Papirus icon theme, then apply it through GNOME settings. Evaluator checks if icon-theme setting contains 'Papirus'. This is similar in difficulty to the original GTK theme task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses gsettings command to check the applied GNOME icon theme, which is the appropriate way to verify theme application
Postconfig appropriately executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme' to capture the current icon theme state
Getter (get_cache_file) correctly reads the cached gsettings output
Metric (check_list) appropriately uses regex pattern matching to verify 'Papirus' appears in the output
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies the end state (theme applied), which implicitly confirms both installation and application
Data flow is semantically correct: postconfig captures state -> getter reads file -> metric validates pattern match
The regex pattern 'Papirus' will correctly match the gsettings output format (e.g., 'Papirus' or Papirus)
